payments.purpose: Own payments feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the payments context.
payments.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

refunds.purpose: Own refunds feature behavior, read models, and UI contracts for the payments context.
refunds.allowedWhen: Always; slice directories are the default root shape for implemented context features.

request-support.purpose: Provide reusable request-support assets shared by multiple payments slices.
request-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
request-support.justification: request-support centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
request-support.createdFor: Multi-slice payments workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
request-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.

seed-support.purpose: Provide reusable seed-support assets shared by multiple payments slices.
seed-support.allowedWhen: Allowed only when capability cannot stay inside one slice and cross-slice reuse is explicit.
seed-support.justification: seed-support centralizes reusable context-local composition that should not duplicate across slices.
seed-support.createdFor: Multi-slice payments workflows that need shared runtime helpers.
seed-support.sunsetWhen: Remove when all consumers can move the behavior back into slice-local modules.

routes.purpose: Expose payments-owned route modules consumed by generated deployable adapters.
routes.allowedWhen: Required whenever the context contributes routes to any deployable.
